voice.summary: Resonance Audio speaks like a knowledgeable shop assistant who lets you try before you buy. It states specs plainly, notes trade-offs honestly and respects that you may not want the dearest pair.
dos: Compare on measurable specs and say which wins
Give price and battery life in plain numbers
donts: Do not hide the weight or battery figure

boilerplate: Resonance Audio is an audio brand with six headphone models, compared side by side on specs, weight, battery life and price.
